limitations: origin is not identity or authorization; unset permits origin-less benchmark clients
per-connection data-message limits, not DDoS or distributed/IP throttling
readiness is sampled subscriber health, not durable delivery or all-network-partition proof
JSON metrics are process-local; send counts are not receipt ACKs; loop delay is not message latency
same-host direct sockets, not hosted CI or load balancer enforcement
